validation.invalidChoice: Choose an option from the list.

validation.futureDate: The date can't be later than today.
validation.otherAlwaysActive: "Other" is always in use and cannot be switched off.
validation.notOnHalfHour: Use a full or half hour, for example 05:00 or 05:30.

validation.phoneAlreadyUsed: This phone belongs to another record.
validation.notInFuture: The appointment must be later than now.
validation.daysOutOfRange: Enter a number of days from 1 to 365.
validation.consentRequired: The customer's consent is needed before the ID document and health information are kept.
validation.invalidIdDocument: Invalid document number: a citizen ID has 12 digits, a passport 6 to 20 letters and digits.
validation.rowsOutOfRange: Enter a number of rows from 100 to 200,000.
validation.managerIsSelf: Nobody can be their own manager.
validation.managerCycle: That person reports to this employee, so the line would loop.
validation.stepMovedTheLead: This step's result moved the lead, so it cannot be removed. Change the lead's status instead.
validation.invalidReminders: Reminder points are hours before the deadline, separated by commas, without repeats (for example 24, 3, 1).

validation.nameTaken: A service with this name already exists.
validation.noPriceTier: No price tier covers this number of sessions.

validation.invalidPercent: Enter a percent above 0 and up to 100.
validation.invalidVoucherCode: A voucher code is 3 to 20 capital letters, digits, or dashes.
validation.promotionHasNoCode: A promotion has no code; only a voucher does.
validation.promotionNotValid: This promotion cannot be used for the chosen service or day.
validation.voucherNotValid: The voucher code is wrong or cannot be used for the chosen service or day.
validation.newHasNoPrevious: Only a renewal follows an earlier contract.
validation.exceptionExcludesPromotion: An exception price cannot be used with a promotion or voucher.
validation.deadlineBeforeStart: The activation deadline must be on or after the start day.
validation.sharesRequired: At least one person is needed.
validation.duplicateEmployee: Each employee can be chosen once.
validation.duplicateCompanion: Each companion can be chosen once.
validation.ptSharesNotAllowed: This service has no PT in charge.
validation.companionsNotAllowed: Only a group package has companions.
validation.tooManyCompanions: More than the package's maximum members.
validation.serviceNotOnSale: This service is not sold in this branch or on this day.
validation.onlyOnCreate: The first payment is entered only when the contract is created.
validation.fileTooLarge: The picture is too large (5 MB at most).
validation.notAnImage: Only PNG, JPEG, or WebP pictures are accepted.
validation.fileInUse: This picture is already used elsewhere.
validation.hoursOutOfRange: The hours must be between 0 and 720.
validation.secondsOutOfRange: The seconds must be between 1 and 3600.
validation.machineCodeTaken: This code already belongs to someone else.
validation.belowEnrolled: The capacity is below the customers already enrolled in an upcoming session.
validation.unknownPlaceholder: A placeholder is used that this email does not offer.
validation.missingPlaceholder: What the customer must be told is missing (see the placeholders marked required).
validation.mandatoryEvent: A mandatory email cannot be switched off.
validation.invalidCode: A code has letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores only.
validation.templateOneSession: A template has one session for each stage.
validation.templateHasNoWeeks: A template has no weeks or session numbers.
validation.notForThisExercise: This field is not used for this kind of exercise (Strength uses weight, reps...; Cardio uses time, speed, heart rate).

validation.plannedExerciseRemoved: An exercise that is in the plan cannot be removed.
validation.notLoggable: The session was cancelled, so it has no log.
validation.noDefaultOption: The Flag or Action list has no active entry.

validation.hasDebt: The contract still has debt; it must be paid in full before a transfer.

validation.refundAbovePaid: The refund cannot be more than what was paid less the value used and the fee.

contracts.title: Contracts
contracts.createDescription: New contracts start as drafts. The contract code is generated automatically.
contracts.editDescription: Only draft contracts can be edited.
contracts.activateBody: The contract takes effect and can be booked. After approval its package, value, sessions, and dates can't be edited.
contracts.cancelBody: The contract can't be used anymore, and its upcoming bookings are cancelled too. This can't be undone.
contracts.searchPlaceholder: Search by contract code, package, or customer
contracts.emptyBody: Create a contract from a customer's page.

fields.imported: Brought over from the old system

contracts.sessionHistoryEmpty: No sessions booked on this contract yet

form.noServices: No service is on sale in the customer's branch yet.
form.exceptionHint: Turn on when the agreed price differs from the tier. It needs a reason and approval, and cannot be used with a promotion or voucher.
form.companionsHint: Search customers of the same branch to add to the group package (up to {max}).
form.companionSearch: Search by code, name, or phone
form.firstPaymentHint: Creates a receipt waiting for approval with the contract. Leave empty if nothing is collected yet.
form.voucherKept: Current voucher: {name}. Type the code again to keep it.

panel.title: Contract price

contracts.rejectBody: The contract has no effect and can't be edited. Delete it and create another if it was wrong.
contracts.unapproveTitle: Send contract {code} back to pending approval?
contracts.unapproveBody: Only possible while the contract has no receipts and no recorded sessions. It needs approval again.
contracts.unapproved: Contract {code} is waiting for approval again
contracts.deleteBody: The contract moves to the trash and leaves every list and report. Receipts and sessions must be deleted first.
contracts.packageHistoryEmpty: Nothing has changed on this contract yet.
contracts.noteBody: The note can change after approval. The package, price, and dates can't.
contracts.deactivateBody: The contract can't be booked, checked in, or used up, and doesn't expire, until it is reactivated. Its future bookings stay and are highlighted.
contracts.reactivateBody: The contract has been deactivated for {days} days, since

employees.title: Employees
employees.description: Staff profiles, sign-in logins, and PT working schedules.
employees.createDescription: The employee code is generated. Each employee has one sign-in login.
employees.editDescription: An employee who has left takes no new bookings; existing ones stay as they are.
employees.emptyBody: Add employees and link each one's sign-in login.
employees.searchPlaceholder: Search by code, name, or phone
employees.loginDescription: A login belongs to one employee only. The employee signs in with it.
employees.isTrainerDescription: Shown on the PT calendar and bookable during working hours.

schedule.title: Working schedule
schedule.description: Weekly shifts. PT sessions can be booked only during working hours; other times are grey on the PT calendar.
schedule.notTrainer: This employee does not teach PT, so they are not on the PT calendar. The schedule is still kept.
schedule.hint: Times follow 30-minute cells, e.g. 05:30. A shift may end at 24:00. Bookings already made are not changed.
schedule.daysOffDescription: Days without work whatever the weekly shifts say. Shown from today on.
schedule.removeDayOffBody: The employee works their weekly shifts on that day.

employees.managerDescription: Told when this person's approval request waits too long.

bookings.calendarDescription: Bookings by trainer for a day, or one trainer's week.
bookings.sessionsDescription: Today's and upcoming sessions, check-ins, and results.
bookings.createDescription: Booking doesn't use a session. A session is used only when it's completed.
bookings.rescheduleDescription: Choose a new trainer or time.
bookings.completeBody: This uses one session of contract {code}. Remaining sessions: {from} → {to}.
bookings.cancelBody: The booking is cancelled and the trainer's time is freed. No session is used.
bookings.cancelCheckedInBody: The customer is already checked in. Cancelling now is an exception: no session is used, and it can't be undone.
bookings.noShowBody: The customer didn't come. No session is used, and the trainer's time is freed.
bookings.customerSearchPlaceholder: Search by code, name, or phone
bookings.noBookableContracts: This customer has no active contract with sessions left.
bookings.noTrainersBody: A manager needs to add employees who teach PT before sessions can be booked.
bookings.trainerNotLinkedTitle: Your login doesn't belong to an employee
bookings.trainerNotLinkedBody: Ask a manager to link your login to your employee profile so you can see your schedule.
bookings.offDutyLegend: Shaded: outside the trainer's on-duty shift. Every time can still be booked.
bookings.deleteBody: The session was booked by mistake. It moves to the trash, the time is freed, and no session is used. This only works while it is Booked and not checked in.

completeDay.title: Complete the sessions of a day
completeDay.body: Marks the Booked sessions you keep ticked as Trained. Each one uses a session of its contract and credits the PT.
completeDay.none: No Booked sessions on that day.

bookings.deleteHistoryTitle: Delete this trained session from the history?
bookings.deleteHistoryBody: One session is refunded to the customer, the session is removed from the PT's credit, and it moves to the trash. The customer gets an email. If the PT's pay period was already paid, the session is deducted in the next period.
bookings.historyDeleted: Session deleted from the history and 1 session refunded
bookings.burnTitle: Add a session that took place
bookings.burnDescription: Adds a trained session by hand, to restore one deleted by mistake or one that took place without a booking. It uses one session of the contract and credits the PT like Đã tập, and is marked as added by hand.

finance.title: Finance
finance.description: Contract payments, debt, income, and expenses.
finance.summaryNote: Contract payments and other income are shown separately until the accounting treatment is decided.
finance.debtDescription: Contracts that still owe money, largest first. Drafts are not included.
finance.cashEmpty: No income or expenses this month
finance.recordPaymentDescription: {debt} outstanding. The payment is confirmed when saved.
finance.recordCashDescription: To correct an entry, void it and record a new one.
finance.deletePaymentBody: It goes to the trash and no longer counts toward the paid amount and debt. It cannot be restored; record it again if needed.
finance.deleteCashBody: It goes to the trash and no longer counts toward the totals. It cannot be restored; record it again if needed.
finance.deleted: Deleted and moved to the trash
finance.editDateBody: Only a user with this permission can. The old and the new day are recorded in the history.
finance.proofBody: The picture of the transfer slip for this receipt. Only people who may see receipts can see it.

contract.unapprove: Send an approved contract back to pending

booking.view: View the PT calendar and sessions

session.deleteHistory: Delete a trained session from the history
session.burn: Add a session that took place (Burn Show)

cash.delete: Delete income and expenses (to the trash)

lead.assign: Reassign leads, hear of new leads
lead.merge: Merge two records of one person
lead.untick: Remove the tick of a consulting step

report.incomeExpense: See the income and expense report
report.incomeExpenseExport: Export the income and expense report
report.manualConfirmations: Report of sessions confirmed by hand

checkin.review: Review hanging sessions and scan errors
checkin.devices: Manage check-in machines and user codes

workout.view: View the workout catalogs and plans

intake.manage: Manage the connections that hand leads to the system

receipts.totals: Totals on receipt and expense lists

roles.title: Roles and permissions
roles.description: A role is a set of permissions, data scopes, and hidden fields. Changes apply at once to everyone with the role.
roles.createDescription: Name it, then choose permissions, data scopes, and hidden fields.
roles.cloneDescription: The new role gets the same permissions, scopes, and hidden fields; adjust it afterwards.

fields.name: Role name
fields.dataScopesHint: "Only their own": customers they created or train, their contracts, sessions they teach, vouchers they entered. Staff "only mine": one's own profile and working schedule. Tasks "only mine": tasks one gave, got, or that went to one's department. Leads "only mine": leads one entered or is in charge of.
fields.fieldMasksHint: Hidden on every screen, and not searchable.

roles.discountThresholdHint: The largest discount, as a percent of the tier price, that holders of this role may approve themselves. A contract with a bigger discount must be approved by a role with a higher limit.

branches.title: Branches
branches.description: Every customer, contract, session, and voucher belongs to a branch. An inactive branch takes no new records.

options.title: Option lists
options.description: The drop-down lists used across the system. An option no longer in use cannot be chosen but stays on old records. "Other" is always last and needs a note.

lists.burnShowReasons: Reasons to add a session (Burn Show)

options.empty: This list has no options yet besides "Other".

otherNotes.title: Notes written with "Other"
otherNotes.description: Notes that come up often are worth adding as options of their own.
otherNotes.empty: Nobody has chosen "Other" in this list yet.

options.codeHint: Optional. When given, it is unique in the list and shown before the name.

parameters.title: System parameters
parameters.description: Values the system uses every day. Changes apply at once and are kept in the history.
parameters.calendarHint: First and last time on the PT calendar. Sessions outside them are still shown.
parameters.codesHint: The prefix comes before the number. Numbers never repeat, even after the prefix changes.

fields.reclaimMinutes: Move on after (working minutes, 0 is off)
fields.taskReminderHours: Shared task reminder points (hours before the deadline)
fields.receptionDepartmentId: Department told when an email fails
fields.cancelCutoffHours: Cancel at least this long before (hours, 0 = off)
fields.scanPairWaitMinutes: Minutes a scan waits for the other side
fields.hangingEscalationHours: Hours before a hanging session is escalated (0 = off)
fields.classGenerateWeeks: Weeks of class sessions made ahead

parameters.tasksHint: The assignee is reminded at each point before the deadline: "24, 3, 1" is 24, 3, and 1 hours before (a dot for fractions, at most 10 points). Whoever gave the task may set its own points. When it passes, both the assignee and the assigner are told.
parameters.leadsHint: Leads in No response, Refused, or No show are contacted again after that many days. A lead not taken care of for the working minutes set (counted only inside the consulting window) moves to the next consultant. An overdue consulting step can still be ticked within the grace period (marked late); after it the step locks as Not done.
parameters.studioHint: Báo Studio creates a task for this department in Tasks. With none chosen, nothing is sent.
parameters.exportsHint: A list with more rows than this cannot be exported until its filters are narrowed.
parameters.mailHint: An email to a customer that cannot go out (the customer has no email, or the provider refused it several times) creates a task for this department in Tasks, so the customer is told another way. With none chosen, no task is made and the email still shows as failed.
parameters.contractsHint: When a customer counts as expiring soon, and when a long deactivation reminds the manager.
parameters.checkinHint: How scans from the fingerprint machines are paired with booked sessions (D-070 to D-072).
parameters.classesHint: The class schedule and the revenue allocated to PTs.

trash.title: Trash
trash.description: Deleted records are kept forever with who deleted them, when, and why. Nobody can purge or restore them.
trash.detailDescription: The record as it was when deleted.

audit.title: Action history
audit.description: Every change in the system: who made it, when, on which record, and the values before and after.
audit.recordIdHint: Paste a record's id (UUID) to see its whole history.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.description: Actions that need approval take effect only when someone else approves them. Nobody approves their own request.

empty.toDecide: Nothing is waiting for your approval.
empty.mine: You have not submitted any requests.

approveBody.payment_create: The payment counts toward the contract's paid amount and debt.
approveBody.cash_create: The entry counts toward the totals.
approveBody.record_delete: The record is deleted and moved to the trash.
approveBody.customer_identity: The customer's new details take effect.
approveBody.contract_create: The contract takes effect and can be booked. After approval it can't be edited.
approveBody.workout_plan: The plan is in use. After approval it is not edited; to change it, make a revision and send it again.
approveBody.voucher_renewal: A change voucher acts when approved: the contract's sessions, value and end date change with it.
approveBody.voucher_upgrade: A change voucher acts when approved: the contract's sessions, value and end date change with it.
approveBody.voucher_hold: A change voucher acts when approved: the contract's sessions, value and end date change with it.
approveBody.voucher_transfer: A change voucher acts when approved: the contract's sessions, value and end date change with it.
approveBody.voucher_branchTransfer: A change voucher acts when approved: the contract's sessions, value and end date change with it.
approveBody.voucher_conversion: A change voucher acts when approved: the contract's sessions, value and end date change with it.
approveBody.voucher_cancellation: A change voucher acts when approved: the contract's sessions, value and end date change with it.

approvals.rejectBody: The request has no effect. The submitter sees the reason you choose.
approvals.submitted: Sent for approval. The change takes effect once approved.

approvalRules.title: Approval matrix
approvalRules.description: Which actions need approval, and who approves. Changes apply at once, also to requests already waiting.
approvalRules.editDescription: A submitter never approves their own request, even with approval rights.
approvalRules.approversHint: Anyone with one of these roles, in the same branch, may approve.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.description: Give and take work between departments and within them. The assignee presses "Accept" before working on it.
tasks.awaitingApproval: {count, plural, one {# request is} other {# requests are}} waiting for your approval.
tasks.summary: {open, plural, one {# open task} other {# open tasks}}, {overdue} overdue
tasks.createDescription: Give it to one person or one department. They are notified at once.
tasks.editDescription: Changing the assignee puts the task back to New, and the new assignee has to accept it.
tasks.waitingInDepartment: Waiting for someone in the department
tasks.cancelBody: The assignee is notified. A cancelled task cannot be reopened.
tasks.remindersHint: Hours before the deadline, for example 24, 3, 1. Leave empty for the shared points of the system. Use a dot for fractions: 0.5 is half an hour.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Tasks given to you, coming due, overdue, comments, and approval requests.

kinds.approvalSubmitted: A request waits for your approval: {title}
kinds.approvalOverdue: A request waiting for approval is overdue: {title}
kinds.leadReclaimed: Lead {code} · {name} was moved to someone else after {minutes} minutes without care
kinds.contractFrozenLong: Contract {code} of {name} has been deactivated for more than {days} days.
kinds.sessionHanging: Session of {customer} with {trainer} still lacks a full check-in after {hours} hours.

checklist.completeDescription: Choose the step's result. A note is optional and never replaces the result.

triggers.beforeAppointment: Opens when booked; due {delay} before the appointment
triggers.atAppointment: Opens when booked; due at the appointment
triggers.recare: Opens with re-care; due on the contact-again day

checklist.reopenDescription: Only for a tick made by mistake. The step opens again; the tick, who made it, and the reason stay in the history.

today.title: Today's tasks
today.description: Consulting steps due today, and those overdue.
today.emptyBody: Consulting steps that come due show here.

checklistAdmin.title: Consulting checklist
checklistAdmin.description: The steps every new lead goes through. Saving makes a new version for new leads; leads already started keep theirs.
checklistAdmin.recareHint: Due on the contact-again day, from the parameter "Re-care after".
checklistAdmin.autoCompleteHint: What opens the step also does it, e.g. booking the visit completes "Book the visit". Records the first result, on time.
checklistAdmin.actionHint: What the system does when the step is done.

visit.showDescription: The customer came in. Enter the ID document and what is missing; the lead becomes a customer and keeps the same record.
visit.noShowDescription: The customer missed the appointment. The lead becomes No show and goes to re-care.
visit.consentHint: ID documents and health information are sensitive personal data; they are encrypted and only permitted roles can see them.

fields.consent: The customer agrees that Flow keeps the ID document and health information

recare.title: Re-care list
recare.description: Leads with no response, refused, or no show, by the day to contact them again.
recare.emptyBody: Leads with no response, refused, or no show appear here with their contact-again day.

scripts.title: Consulting scripts
scripts.description: Situations with answers in Vietnamese and English. Consultants copy them from a lead. Scripts are never deleted; switch one off to hide it.

leadAudit.title: Consulting audit
leadAudit.description: How on time each consultant's steps are, and which leads need a look. Steps count once they are due; the score also counts the fields the criteria ask for.
leadAudit.toCheckHint: Leads still in the journey with a late or skipped step or a missing field, most urgent first.
leadAudit.emptyConsultants: There are no leads in this period.
leadAudit.emptyToCheck: Nothing to check: every due step is on time and every field is there.

tab.title: Audit
tab.hint: Computed from the steps' deadlines and the lead's fields; it is not a manager's grade.

queue.title: Not audited yet
queue.hint: {total, plural, =0 {Everyone has been audited} other {# not audited yet, the oldest first}}. Open a lead to grade it; it leaves this list once graded.

manager.title: Manager audit
manager.none: No manager has audited this lead yet.
manager.gradeDescription: A Fail names what was not met. Every grade is kept; the latest one counts.

auditCriteria.title: Audit criteria
auditCriteria.description: What the automatic consulting audit asks of every lead besides the timing of its steps. A criterion that is switched off counts for nobody; a weight of 1 to 10 says how much it counts. Changes apply to every score at once.

consultingReport.title: Consulting dashboard
consultingReport.description: The leads created in the period, how far each got, and how on time the consulting was. Rates are of the leads created in the period.
consultingReport.empty: There are no leads in this period.

funnel.title: Funnel
funnel.chartLabel: Leads, consulted, booked, shown, and contracted

steps.title: Completion of each consulting step
steps.description: The checklist measures the process, not the people: how often each step is done and how the leads that got it fare in booking, show, and contract against those that did not, to change steps that are redundant or missing. Each rate cell reads: did | did not.
steps.chartHint: The share of leads the step was due for in which it was done.
steps.empty: No step has come due in this period.

leadAnalysis.title: Lead analysis
leadAnalysis.description: The leads created in the period by contact channel, source, Organic or Paid, need, nationality, and refusal reason, and how far each group got.
leadAnalysis.total: {count, plural, one {# lead} other {# leads}} in this period.
leadAnalysis.empty: There are no leads in this period.

leadReceivers.title: Lead receiving
leadReceivers.description: Leads are shared by weighted turn: weight 2 takes two leads in each round where weight 1 takes one. Switch receiving off for someone on leave or busy; only people within their working hours are dealt leads.
leadReceivers.name: Consultant
leadReceivers.empty: Nobody receives leads in your branches yet.

mail.title: Emails sent
mail.empty: No email has been sent to this customer yet.

services.title: Services and price tiers
services.description: The services on sale and their prices by session range. Each change of prices is a new version with a start day; contracts already signed keep the price they were signed at.

tiers.title: Price tiers
tiers.hint: Each tier is a session range with a unit price per session and a validity. A count between two tiers is refused, never given the nearest tier.
tiers.empty: No price list yet. Add the first version to sell this service.
tiers.newVersionHint: Enter all the tiers again. The new prices apply only to contracts made from the start day on; contracts already signed keep the old price.

packages.title: Quick-pick packages
packages.hint: The counts often sold become buttons on the contract form. A button only fills in the number of sessions; the price is still looked up from the tiers.

lookup.title: Try a price
lookup.hint: Enter any number of sessions to see the unit price, total, display name, and end date as the contract form would.

promotions.title: Promotions and vouchers
promotions.description: A percent or an amount off, with dates, applied to the tier price and not an exception price. A contract takes at most one promotion and one voucher; the promotion comes first and the voucher is taken off what is left.

cashBook.title: Cash book
cashBook.description: Opening, in, out, and closing of each branch by payment method, and day by day.
cashBook.empty: No income or expense in this period.
cashBook.note: Closing = opening + in − out. Only approved, undeleted receipts and vouchers count; Admin sets the opening balance of each branch and method, and the books count only from that day.

opening.title: Opening cash balance
opening.body: The cash the branch held in this method when it began using the cash book. Changing it moves every closing balance after it and is logged.

incomeExpense.title: Income and expense
incomeExpense.description: Contract payments, other income, and expenses by category in the period.
incomeExpense.empty: No income or expense in this period.

contractReport.title: Contract report
contractReport.description: Revenue, debt, new and renewed contracts, and contracts expiring or running out, by service and session band.
contractReport.note: New, renewed, value and debt count approved contracts dated in the period; revenue is the money received in the period; expiring and running out are as of today, by the thresholds in Parameters.

exceptionPrices.title: Exception prices
exceptionPrices.description: The share of contracts with an exception price and the difference from the tier price, by creator and approver.
exceptionPrices.note: Difference = (tier price − approved price) × sessions bought, over approved contracts with an exception price. Contracts brought over from the old system have no tier price and are left out.

files.unavailable: The picture could not be loaded.

sessionStatuses.title: Session statuses
sessionStatuses.description: Each status of a session: whether it uses one of the contract's sessions, whether it credits the PT, and its color.
sessionStatuses.note: A change applies to the next status change only: every session keeps the rule applied when its status was set. Locked once set means it cannot be changed back (Trained). Cancelled frees the PT's time; the other statuses hold it.
sessionStatuses.editBody: The labels, whether it uses a session, credits the PT, locks once set, and its color.
sessionStatuses.bookedFixed: Booking never uses a session, credits the PT, or locks; only its labels and color can change.

checkin.title: Check-in
checkin.description: Sessions that lack a full check-in, scans that could not serve a session, and the check-in machines.
checkin.hangingEmpty: No session is waiting for a check-in.

scanErrors.UNKNOWN_USER: No customer or employee has this user code
scanErrors.NO_BOOKING: No booked session fits this scan
scanErrors.PAIR_TOO_LATE: The other side scanned too long ago
scanErrors.CONTRACT_NOT_ACTIVE: The contract is not active or has expired
scanErrors.CONTRACT_NO_REMAINING_SESSIONS: The contract has no sessions left
scanErrors.BOOKING_OUTSIDE_CONTRACT_PERIOD: The session is outside the contract's dates

checkin.manualIntro: Sessions confirmed by hand from {from} to {to}: {total}.
checkin.addDeviceBody: Each machine belongs to one branch and has its own key.
checkin.devicesEmpty: No machine is registered. Machines are attached later; the scan API is ready.
checkin.devicesNote: A machine sends its scans to POST /api/v1/checkin/scans with its key in the x-device-key header. The CRM never stores a fingerprint or a face image.
checkin.keyBody: Copy it into the machine now. It is shown only once; a lost key is replaced with a new one.
checkin.machineCodeHint: The code the fingerprint machine knows this person by. Only the code is stored.
checkin.codeTaken: This code already belongs to someone else.

classes.title: Class schedule
classes.description: The week's group classes: enroll customers and mark attendance.
classes.noClassContracts: The customer has no active group-class contract with sessions left.
classes.addDescription: A class is a time slot that repeats every week. Its sessions are made ahead for the coming weeks.
classes.editDescription: The days and the time cannot change: switch this class off and make a new one. Changes reach the sessions to come.
classes.activeHint: Switching a class off cancels the coming sessions nobody is enrolled in.

ptRevenue.title: PT revenue allocation
ptRevenue.description: One row per PT and contract: the allocation value, the sessions taught in the period, and the PT's revenue, in GymMaster's columns.
ptRevenue.empty: No session is credited to a PT in this period.
ptRevenue.noRows: This PT only taught classes in the period.
ptRevenue.note: Allocation value = the contract value after discounts, excluding VAT. PT allocation = credited sessions × allocation per session × the service's commission rate × the timesheet rate (Parameters). Credited sessions are trained, no-show and Burn Show sessions; a session deleted from the history is not counted. A session belongs to the period of its scheduled day. Class sessions with at least one customer present are counted apart and carry no revenue yet. Payable = the PT allocation of the sessions not paid yet, less the paid sessions deleted from the history since (Adjustments); an adjustment is taken off the PT's next payout.

payout.title: Pay {name}
payout.description: Pays the sessions of {from} – {to} not paid yet, less the paid sessions deleted from the history. The voucher is made at once; the amount is worked out by the system.

bookingReport.title: Booking report
bookingReport.description: The PT sessions of the period: customer, phone, check-in and check-out times, status, staff, and created date.
bookingReport.empty: There is no session in this period.

overview.endingSoonHint: Ending within {days} days or {sessions} sessions left or fewer (Parameters)
overview.byHour: PT sessions by hour of the day
overview.noSessions: There is no PT session in the period.
overview.note: New leads count by the day they were created. Members who trained have a PT session or a class session used in the period. PT sessions are the ones that credit a PT, by the hour they started. Revenue is valid receipts by month, without opening balances.

ptPayouts.title: PT payouts
ptPayouts.description: The payouts to PTs: the voucher, the period, the sessions paid, and the adjustments taken off. A payout whose voucher is deleted or rejected stands no more, and its sessions can be paid again.
ptPayouts.empty: No payout has been made yet.

emailTemplates.title: Customer email templates
emailTemplates.description: The words of each automatic email to customers, in Vietnamese and English. Customers of a foreign nationality group get the English one, the others the Vietnamese one.
emailTemplates.editDescription: Write the subject and body in both languages. Use placeholders in curly braces; the preview below uses sample data.
emailTemplates.placeholdersHint: Use only the placeholders below. A required one must be in the body of both languages.
emailTemplates.subject: Subject
emailTemplates.enabledHint: Off, customers no longer get it; the words are kept. Mandatory emails have no switch.

staffNotifications.title: Email and phone notifications
staffNotifications.description: Choose which important notifications reach you by email and on your phone, as well as in the app. A type Admin made mandatory is always sent.
staffNotifications.choicesHint: Tasks due soon or overdue, requests waiting for approval, leads assigned or moved, and sessions without a full check-in. Both are on by default.

device.title: This device
device.description: Get push notifications on this phone or browser while you are signed in.

state.notSetUp: Push notifications are not set up for this system.
state.unsupported: This browser does not support push notifications.
state.needsInstall: On an iPhone, push notifications work only for an app added to the Home Screen.
state.denied: You blocked notifications for this site. Allow them again in the browser's settings.
state.off: This device does not get push notifications yet.

device.devices: Your account has {count} devices that get push notifications.
device.turnOn: Turn on notifications on this device
device.turnOff: Turn off notifications on this device
device.turnedOn: Notifications are on for this device
device.turnedOff: Notifications are off for this device
device.failed: That did not work. Please try again.
device.installHint: Open this page in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. Then open the app from its new icon and turn notifications on here.

notificationSettings.title: Staff notifications
notificationSettings.description: Mark which notifications must go by email or to the phone even when an employee turned them off. A push reaches only employees who turned it on on a phone.

workoutCatalog.title: Workout catalogs
workoutCatalog.description: The equipment, body areas, exercises and stages that plans are made from. An entry that is no longer used cannot be chosen for a new plan but stays on the old ones.

workoutPlans.title: Customers' workout plans
workoutPlans.description: Plans by week and session, made from a template or from scratch. The Master approves before use; an approved plan is not edited, a change is a revision.
workoutPlans.templatesDescription: Models of a plan: stages with one model session each. Customers' plans are made from approved templates.
workoutPlans.customerEmpty: This customer has no plan yet.
workoutPlans.waiting: Waiting for the Master. The plan is not in use yet and cannot be edited.
workoutPlans.rejected: The Master rejected it. Edit it and send it again.
workoutPlans.revisionStarted: A revision was started to edit
workoutPlans.replaces: A revision of a plan in use: see that plan
workoutPlans.revisionOf: A revision is being written or waits for approval: see it
workoutPlans.replacedBy: Replaced by a newer plan: see it
workoutPlans.saveAndSend: Save and send to the Master
workoutPlans.sent: Sent for approval. The plan can be used once the Master approves it.

workoutLogs.title: Session logs
workoutLogs.description: The log of each PT session: before, during (plan and actual on one row) and after.
workoutLogs.customerEmpty: This customer has no session logs yet.

fields.otherNote: Say what the other choice is

workoutLogs.noExercises: No exercises in this session yet. Add one from the catalog.
workoutLogs.readOnly: You can only read this log.
workoutLogs.escalationWaiting: Escalation sent to the manager and the Master, waiting to be handled.

workoutEscalations.title: Workout escalations
workoutEscalations.description: Each time a coach chose Stop + Escalation in a session log. The manager or the Master marks it seen and writes a direction.

workoutDashboard.title: Weekly workout dashboard
workoutDashboard.description: Over every customer: the share of each Flag and each Action among the sets recorded in the week, the customers with a Flag other than Normal, the comparison with the week before and the escalations waiting. Click a share to see its sets.
workoutDashboard.drill: The sets of the chosen share
workoutDashboard.escalationsHint: Waiting for the manager or the Master

totals.nonNormal: Customers with a Flag other than Normal

workoutProgress.title: Training progress
workoutProgress.noPlan: The customer has no approved plan.
workoutProgress.noSessions: No session of this customer has a log yet.
workoutProgress.noHistory: No set has a Flag other than Normal or an Action other than None.

contractChanges.title: Change vouchers
contractChanges.empty: This contract has no change vouchers yet.
contractChanges.renewalDescription: Adds months, days or sessions. The renewal amount is added to the contract's debt and collected by receipts. The voucher acts only once approved.
contractChanges.holdDescription: Pauses the contract at the customer's request. The end date moves back by the days held; sessions booked in these days are cancelled when the voucher is approved.
contractChanges.fromHint: dd/MM/yyyy, empty is the day after it ends

fields.credit: Value credited for the sessions left

contractChanges.exchangeDescription: Exchanges the sessions left for a new package. The sessions left become the new package's sessions; the new price less the value credited is added to what is owed. The voucher acts only once approved.
contractChanges.transferDescription: Gives all the sessions left to another customer. This contract has none left; the receiver gets a new contract with the same end date, already paid to the value transferred. Nothing may be owed. Sessions booked from today are cancelled when the voucher is approved.
contractChanges.branchTransferDescription: Moves the contract to another branch for a fee that is added to what is owed. Sessions booked from today are cancelled when the voucher is approved; the customer books again at the new branch.
contractChanges.customerSearch: Search by code, name or phone
contractChanges.cancellationDescription: Ends the contract at the customer's request: no sessions left, booked sessions cancelled, nothing owed. The refund is recorded as an expense voucher when the voucher is approved. Not possible while a session is in progress.

taskReport.title: Tasks
taskReport.description: Tasks given, done on time, done late and overdue, by person and by department. A task counts in the period its deadline falls in.
taskReport.empty: No task has a deadline in this period.
taskReport.note: On-time rate = tasks done on time / (tasks done + tasks overdue). Tasks still open and not yet due, and cancelled ones, are not in the rate. The department is the one on the person's employee record, or the one the task was given to.

intake.title: Lead sources
intake.description: The connections that hand leads to the system (the website form, WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, Gmail, Zalo OA). Each source has its own way of proving itself.
intake.empty: No source yet. Add the first to receive leads from the website form.
intake.note: The key is shown once, when it is made or replaced. It belongs on the website's server (never in a page a visitor can read) and goes in the x-intake-key header to /api/v1/intake/website.
intake.addBody: Leads from this source belong to the branch and channel below, and go to the consultants in turn.
intake.keyBody: Copy this key now and put it on the website's server. It is not shown again; if it is lost, replace it with a new one.
intake.appSecretHint: The App Secret of the Meta app, used to check the signature of every message. It is stored encrypted and not shown again.
intake.webhookBody: Paste this address and verify token into the Webhook settings of the Meta app (WhatsApp: the messages field; Messenger and Instagram: the messages field of the Page or the Instagram account). They are not shown again; if lost, use New key to get a new verify token.
intake.pageTokenBody: Paste the Page access token (with leads_retrieval) of the Facebook Page. The system uses it to read the answers of the Lead Ads forms; it is stored encrypted and not shown again. Paste a new token to replace it.
intake.inboundBody: Paste this address (it contains the key) into the inbound webhook of the inbound-mail service (Postmark). Then, in the gym's Gmail, add the service's inbound email address as a forwarding address; the confirmation code Gmail sends will show under this source's name.
intake.oaSecretHint: The OA Secret Key of the Zalo app (app settings → Official Account), used to check the signature of every event. It is stored encrypted and not shown again.
intake.zaloBody: Paste this address into the Webhook settings of the Zalo app, then turn on the events for users sending messages and users sharing their information. The address's domain must first be verified with Zalo (a DNS record). The system only receives; it never sends through Zalo.
